name: Historic Centre of San Gimignano
description: San Gimignano is a walled medieval hill town in Tuscany, about 56 km south of Florence. Rival noble families once raised some 72 tower-houses here, some reaching 50 m, to show off their power. Fourteen still stand, giving the hilltop its famous skyline. Inside the walls, churches and the town hall hold frescoes from the 14th and 15th centuries.
